remarks:
Great Potential on Dutch Hill Road! Discover the possibilities with this parcel being subdivided from a larger property in the Town of Ashford. Featuring approximately 400 feet of road frontage and 545 feet of depth, this property offers plenty of space to bring your plans to life.

The lot has been cleared approximately 300 feet back from the road, with a few trees thoughtfully left throughout the cleared area. The terrain is generally level with a moderate slope toward the rear, where scrub brush and a mixture of young trees, including pine trees, create a natural backdrop.

Enjoy impressive country views and a rural setting with electricity available at the road. Conveniently located just minutes from Route 219 and Springville, offering easy access while still enjoying the surrounding countryside.

With generous road frontage, a substantial cleared area, and plenty of room to expand, this property offers an excellent opportunity to create your own vision. Parcel is being subdivided from a larger property; final acreage, boundaries, and dimensions are subject to survey and subdivision approval.
